analyst.text: Milwaukee's slide reached nine straight with losses to the Knicks (by 32) and the Lakers. Taylor Jenkins has admitted "what we're doing right now is not working", and Kyle Kuzma is publicly demanding urgency. Tyler Herro is back and scored 27 against the Lakers. Orlando just closed a 2-2 West trip with their first winning streak of the season, with Franz Wagner scoring 30-plus in three straight. Despite a long list of absentees, including Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs, the Magic carry the better mood into an NBA Cup home game.
